title: Restaurant Manager - Italian Speaking
experience: The ideal candidate will have strong restaurant management experience, excellent communication and leadership skills, and a genuine passion for Italian hospitality and cuisine
description_text:
Our client, a well-established Italian restaurant in St. Julian’s, is looking for an experienced and motivated Restaurant Manager – Italian Speaking to join their team.
 The ideal candidate will have strong restaurant management experience, excellent communication and leadership skills, and a genuine passion for Italian hospitality and cuisine. The role involves overseeing the daily operations of the restaurant while ensuring high standards of service, guest satisfaction, and team performance.
 Key Responsibilities
 Oversee the daily operations of the restaurant, ensuring smooth and efficient service.
 Lead, motivate, and manage the front-of-house team.
 Ensure high standards of customer service and hospitality are consistently maintained.
 Welcome and interact with guests, ensuring a positive and memorable dining experience.
 Manage reservations, table allocation, and service flow.
 Coordinate closely with the kitchen and management team to ensure efficient operations.
 Train and support staff to maintain service standards and restaurant procedures.
 Monitor staff performance, attendance, and daily responsibilities.
 Handle guest feedback and resolve any service-related issues professionally.
 Assist with stock control, ordering, and monitoring of restaurant supplies.
 Ensure compliance with hygiene, health and safety, and company procedures.
 Support the management team with scheduling, cost control, and other operational matters.
 Requirements
 Previous experience in a Restaurant Manager, Assistant Restaurant Manager, or similar supervisory role .
 Fluent Italian and good English are essential.
 Strong leadership and team management skills.
 Excellent communication and customer service skills.
 Good knowledge of restaurant operations and service standards.
 Professional, organised, and hands-on approach.
 Ability to work well under pressure in a busy restaurant environment.
 Passion for Italian cuisine, hospitality, and delivering an excellent guest experience.
 Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
 What We Offer
 Full-time employment with an established restaurant group.
 A dynamic and professional working environment.
 Opportunity to work within an authentic Italian/Sicilian restaurant concept.
 Opportunities for professional growth and development.
 If you are an experienced restaurant professional who speaks Italian and enjoys leading a team while delivering exceptional hospitality, we would love to hear from you.
